reading: Continuous annular lumen, three rounded neck bands, cast root and two pierced ears are visible in actual final renders. Original grain is visible in the mouth macro and inside, subtler under broad highlights. Shape, side projection, flange outline, lip thickness and grain are conditional estimates, not measured reconstruction from a calibrated photo. Reverse is explicitly simplified; tiny unreadable casting marks are not invented.
interface_reserve: Two targeted candidate solid checks show no reported surface crossing or sampled vertex inclusion; 17 BVH ambiguities were resolved by logged unanimous direct float64 rays. This does not certify an exact gap, gas-flow section, OEM stack or roadworthy fit. Estimated25mm lumen versus22mm head and joint spacing remain open; O-rings, sleeve, clamps, carburetor and fasteners are distinct missing units.
runtime_reserve: Actual desktop Chromium softwareWebGL load and pixels, one mesh/129722 triangles, four views. Inspector framing/light differ from native art review. No physical iPhone test, mobile LOD or appearance parity.
capture_timing: Babylon image was captured while final native views were being completed; its historic explanatory overlay remains true to that moment. Geometry, source and GLB were unchanged throughout; current catalogue prose now describes the closed isolated candidate.
